backup.production_rule: s110 (D-358): role laundry and capability report_supply, utility rates, staff receipt drafts and the KPI tab read model. Two new tables (RLS on; no client grants, service_role select+insert on the receipt drafts only), nine new RPCs/internals, staff_access_allowed redefined, one column grant (select item_id, title on inventory_item_options to service_role) and two live functions patched in place (manage_staff_access role list, record_inventory_usage gate). Nothing existing is dropped. Run only on a restore point younger than one hour, after the s108 release is applied. restore_point is the backup used for the rehearsal; the orchestrator re-stamps both fields on the fresh backup taken before the apply.
backup.notes: Phase backfill, as s107/s108: the function bodies contain deletes (undo of a staff receipt, 30-day trim of unconfirmed drafts), which the expand check refuses. Applying the migration changes no row. The staff_access_profiles role check is replaced by a wider one in the same transaction.
